completeCurrentCard.procedure:
Action; range 60 feet; V/S/M/F; base 10 RP; concentration up to 60 elapsed seconds. Before payment choose one actual opaque `planeKey` already established in campaign/source records and one perceived center within 60 feet and line of effect. Create a fixed 15-foot-radius spherical ward, clipped by actual solid center line of effect.

Eligibility for ordinary physical entry uses committed operational provenance: `lastArrivedFromPlaneKey == chosenPlaneKey` or, where no travel record exists, exact `createdFromPlaneKey == chosenPlaneKey`. Creature type, Elemental/outsider label, mortal Wheel name, soul/native origin and current location are insufficient. Indeterminate provenance remains Indeterminate.

For an incoming cross-plane transition do NOT read stale committed history. Use AC5-PLANAR-ARRIVAL-03: snapshot immutable `prospectiveOriginPlaneKey` from the body’s actual origin plane immediately before that transition and evaluate this destination ward before placement. Any part of the body/group terminal footprint entering the sphere makes that body eligible for the ward check. A successful atomic transition then commits `lastArrivedFromPlaneKey = prospectiveOriginPlaneKey`; failed transit leaves prior history unchanged and gives no free provenance report.

An eligible creature already inside when the ward forms is not expelled, suppressed or damaged. It may move within and leave; after leaving it cannot cross inward while still eligible. Supported walking/carried/forced inward movement stops at the last legal exterior position, with no free shove/damage. A carried creature remains a separate body. An actual teleport/portal destination whose footprint would enter fails atomically for that body/group under its own cost rules. Outside-to-outside teleport beyond the sphere is unaffected; no imaginary path is tested.

The ward creates no support. Under AC5-PLANAR-FALL-03, continuous unsupported ordinary Falling is never suspended at the boundary: if the last exterior point is unsupported, the Fall Marker continues through the sphere; the body then counts as already inside. This exception applies only to unsupported continuous Falling, not grounded/otherwise supported crossing.

Suppression opens the boundary and clocks continue. Bodies entering during suppression are already-inside on resumption: no ejection/crush. Ending grants no damage, concealment, attack immunity, information disclosure or native-plane determination.
newScopedAuthorship: Opaque actual planeKey + travel/source provenance predicate

AC5-PRICE-01.classification: NEW scoped AC5 price ordering; preserves accepted AC4 Dampening and existing final Influence
rule: Validate that the activation is an actual spell cast and determine the actual casting body at commitment.

Create pricing buckets. creditableBase starts as the actual ordinary base RP amount after exact base-only reductions/waivers/minima. preNexusExtras contains printed ordinary RP extras and Dissonance/strain surcharges that remain discountable but are never Barrier-pool credit. Protected principal such as Resonance Barrier X, materials, HP, ammunition, charges and uses stay outside these buckets.

If at least one operative Resonance Nexus contains the caster at commitment, apply one total -2 to the combined discountable pre-Dampening buckets, minimum0: reduce creditableBase first, then preNexusExtras. Overlapping Nexuses never stack.

If accepted Resonance Dampening Field applies, add its mandatory +2 RP only after Nexus/ordinary reductions. Dampening is noncreditable and Nexus never subtracts it. A genuine charge/use-only spell with no ordinary RP-price interface still receives this accepted +2 interface; Nexus has no earlier RP bucket to reduce.

Apply one pending final Resonance Influence Ease/Burden to the resulting RP-priced spell amount, minimum0. For Barrier accounting only, Ease reduces creditableBase first, then remaining preNexusExtras, then Dampening/other noncreditable final components; Burden adds only noncreditable cost.
Commit the final affordable RP amount together with Action/components/concentration transition. Countering, suppression, save/failure or replacement gives no refund.
AC5-PRICE-01.barrierCreditAllocation: Resonance Barrier pool credit = 5 × (final creditableBasePaid + protectedX). No Dissonance, printed surcharge, Dampening, Burden or other nonbase extra becomes pool credit even if paid. Base-only waivers can reduce creditableBase to0; Nexus/Ease allocations above may also reduce it. Protected X is fully paid separately and fully creditable.
AC5-PRICE-01.chargeOnlyBoundary: An ancestry/use-only spell spends its actual use and has no ordinary RP bucket unless another exact interface creates one. Nexus therefore cannot manufacture or discount a price. Accepted AC4 Dampening alone can add its +2 RP interface; final Influence may then modify that +2. A positive RP amount requires an existing lawful personal RP pool. Paying RP for a nonspell still does not make it a spell.

AC5-SUMMON-TARGET-01.classification: NEW extension limited to Greater Fire Pet and Faction Champion; does not alter AC4 Water Pet/Envoy scope
AC5-SUMMON-TARGET-01.rule: While either AC5 finite summoned body actually exists, treat it mechanically as an active creature and as a living ally for ordinary HP-healing/living-creature targeting, including Cleric Healing Rite. This does not establish natural biology, native plane, soul, corpse, breeding, nourishment, faction personhood or loot. A Null Disabled 0 body remains the same target while its original source persists and can be legally healed above 0. If the source has already ended/expired/replaced/dismissed the body, there is no target to heal.
AC5-SUMMON-TARGET-01.nullLifecycle: Bind both profiles to the accepted finiteSummonFamiliarMirrorBeast Null recipient branch: qualifying Null damage to 0 replaces only damage-caused disappearance with Disabled 0 while original source duration persists; later qualifying Null hits do not create organic death/Wounds; independent expiry/dismissal/concentration/replacement still ends the body. Ordinary non-Null damage reaching 0 uses the body's normal finite-summon disappearance.

AC5-ROOT-01.classification: NEW AC5 damage-root checkpoints consistent with accepted Null root ownership
AC5-ROOT-01.livingMagma: On a failed initial CON save that successfully establishes the recurring Living Magma rider, create one damage root immediately even though no initial damage packet occurs. Dealer is the caster. Record the caster's then-current unsuppressed Null Veil flag on that root. The three later tick packets are descendants and inherit the creation-time flag; later Veil changes do not rewrite it. A suppressed scheduled tick creates no child packet and is consumed with no makeup.
AC5-ROOT-01.greaterFirePetAttack: Each commanded Fire Pet attack that reaches its actual damage checkpoint creates a distinct root with dealer = Fire Pet body, not owner/controller.
AC5-ROOT-01.greaterFirePetAura: Each qualifying recipient's aura START checkpoint creates its own damage root with dealer = Fire Pet body. One shared d6 roll may feed several recipients but does not merge root identity or copy another actor's Veil. Evaluate the pet body's own Veil at each recipient root creation.
AC5-ROOT-01.massiveBlast: At instantaneous damage resolution create one root per original recipient, all with dealer = caster and the same cast ID. A shared 5d8 roll does not merge recipient roots.

reuse: BAN-ADMIT-03 current-space preflight, internal creation and legal visitor admission

notReused: ordinary Banishment concentration when the AC5 spell authors another duration
AC5-BANISH-EXT-01.suppression: Actual suppression of the exile application closes/ends that application through reused closure; it never pauses and resumes exile.
AC5-BANISH-EXT-01.bodySourceEnding: If the primary finite creature source ends first, that body ends under its source, then the AC5 exile immediately closes. AC5-PLANAR-META-01.classification: NEW spell/campaign metadata for Planar Protection, Planar Binding and Alignment Portal only; not a master cosmology
AC5-PLANAR-META-01.planeKey: An opaque stable ID for an actual plane record already established by campaign/source authority. The key carries no automatic alignment, deity, native-species, soul-destination, Wheel, dominion or tributary meaning.
AC5-PLANAR-META-01.siteId: A stable known physical destination site on one planeKey with actual location/footprint/support data.
AC5-PLANAR-META-01.travelProvenance: On a successful cross-plane body transition using a reviewed source, the Director may record currentBody.lastArrivedFromPlaneKey = the actual origin planeKey and the transport event ID. A creation source may instead explicitly provide createdFromPlaneKey. These are operational travel/source provenance only and do not establish native origin or soul identity.
AC5-PLANAR-META-01.unknown: If a required planeKey/provenance fact is not established, it remains Indeterminate. Spells do not secretly discover or fabricate it.
AC5-PLANAR-META-01.prospectiveArrival: For a particular cross-plane transition, snapshot prospectiveOriginPlaneKey = the actual planeKey containing the body immediately before that transit. Destination-side Planar Protection and other arrival predicates evaluate this immutable prospective value before placement. Only a successful atomic transition commits currentBody.lastArrivedFromPlaneKey = prospectiveOriginPlaneKey and the event ID. Failed/countered/blocked transit leaves prior provenance unchanged. createdFromPlaneKey remains creation provenance and is used for ordinary physical ward entry only when no current cross-plane transition supplies a prospective origin.
AC5-PLANAR-META-01.partialFootprint: A destination/entry is ward-eligible if any part of the body/group terminal footprint would enter the protected sphere. All bodies in one carried/group transit are checked independently before atomic placement.

AC5-CHAMPION-ALLY-01.classification: NEW Faction Champion source-specific 'allied faction' gate

Formation requires: (1) an actual spell-specific alliedStatus=true record for this caster/faction; (2) current standing > 0; (3) actual invocation permission under the current faction system; and (4) no explicit aid prohibition. Membership remains a separate credential and is not inferred from alliedStatus or standing. Faction Ally's membership+permission gate and Faction Portal's positive-standing+known-HQ gate remain distinct and are not imported.

AC5-ALIGN-PORTAL-META-01.classification: NEW Alignment Portal-specific compatibility metadata, not objective plane taxonomy
AC5-ALIGN-PORTAL-META-01.rule: An actual plane record may carry alignmentPortalCompatibility = a set of canonical nine-point alignment keys and one or more known Alignment-Portal siteIds. This is travel compatibility for this spell only. It does not assert that the plane is objectively 'Lawful Good', that a mortal Wheel label equals it, that inhabitants are native there, or that souls/deities map to it.

AC5-ANTIMAGIC-SUMMON-01.classification: NEW suppression profile limited to Greater Fire Pet and Faction Champion
AC5-ANTIMAGIC-SUMMON-01.rule: While any part of one of these bodies intersects operative Lesser Antimagic, keep the same body identity, HP, source deadline, Null Disabled state and genuine cargo. Speed becomes 0 and the body cannot take Actions, companion commands, attacks or Fire-Pet aura checkpoints. Intrinsic manifested gear grants no separate function while suppressed. Genuine carried items remain the same items; if actual physical custody becomes impossible under ordinary item rules, place/drop them normally. Leaving suppression restores only still-live source permissions with the same HP/deadline and no refill/resummon.

AC5-ANTIMAGIC-IO-03.classification: NEW Lesser Antimagic input/output checkpoints and protected-book interpretation; scoped only to this AC5 field
rule: At legal spell/effect commitment, costs/components/concentration/cadence resolve normally before suppression.
For an ongoing expression, suppress each local body/anchor/area portion that intersects the operative field.

For an instantaneous spell or magical nonspell originating outside, evaluate its actual recipient, affected area and/or destination manifestation checkpoint. Any local payload that would manifest inside the operative field is suppressed at resolution. Damage/healing inside creates no packet/root/rider; an indivisible relocation with a destination footprint intersecting the field fails atomically at origin. Outside-to-outside teleport/nonpath travel is unaffected even if an imaginary straight line crosses the sphere.
No fictional projectile/path is invented for nonprojectile effects. A genuine projectile/path that physically enters the field follows its own physical/magical source semantics.

An exact dispel effect whose selected target is the Lesser Antimagic application itself may address/end that field without being suppressed solely by the target field. It still needs its own legal source, cost, perception/range/LoE/check. Another separate Antimagic field can suppress the dispeller normally. This narrow self-dispel exception prevents an oscillating indispellable field and grants no passage to unrelated effects.

Wizard Spell Preservation: Antimagic may suppress magical spellbook usability/access effects while intersecting, but it does not erase the permanent class-source fact that the primary spellbook cannot be destroyed/erased/rendered permanently unreadable by non-artifact mundane or magical means. Suppression therefore does not create a window for permanent ordinary destruction. Artifact-level exceptions remain source-governed.
AC5-ANTIMAGIC-IO-03.status: superseded by AC5-ANTIMAGIC-IO-04 for current Repair04 operation semantics

AC5-PLANAR-ARRIVAL-03.classification: NEW AC5 prospective-arrival provenance timing; operational metadata only
AC5-PLANAR-ARRIVAL-03.rule: For every cross-plane transit into a Planar Protection destination, snapshot prospectiveOriginPlaneKey from the body’s actual plane immediately before the transit. Evaluate the destination ward against that value before placement, regardless of stale lastArrivedFromPlaneKey. On success commit lastArrivedFromPlaneKey=prospective origin; on failure keep the prior record unchanged. No failure reveals hidden provenance/cosmology beyond ordinary observed failure.

rule: Alignment Portal creates two fixed linked vertical apertures, each 5 feet wide by 8 feet high. At cast time record each aperture base-center, floor elevation and outward normal. Origin pose is chosen in a perceived clear supported space within60/LoE. Destination site metadata must already provide one known portalPose with clear supported 5-by-5 staging space on each side; missing pose/clearance makes the cast illegal rather than allowing remote tactical placement.

The gateway is bidirectional while active. A voluntary crossing is planar/extradimensional travel through a physical gateway and is NOT teleportation. No Escape blocks voluntary crossing; Verdict Absolute and Reign of Ashes do not. This classification is Alignment-Portal-only.

Entering the aperture costs 5 feet of base ordinary movement. Apply actual terrain, crawling and squeezing costs to that 5-foot traversal. A Large body may use a 5-foot aperture only if ordinary one-size-smaller squeeze is legal; squeezing adds +1 movement cost per foot and its real penalties. Carried creatures are separate bodies and all members of one packet must fit/support and pass arrival blockers.

Forced movement may carry a body through only if the forcing source supplies enough real movement/path and the body/group passes all arrival gates. Forced movement spends no voluntary movement budget and does not become voluntary travel; No Escape therefore does not block the forced crossing merely by its voluntary wording.

Crossing maps the traveler’s facing relative to the entry normal to the corresponding destination exit normal. Destination placement is the nearest fitting unoccupied supported space touching the exit staging side, using fixed neutral board order for ties. No search through barriers and no body bisection.
AC5-PORTAL-GEOMETRY-03.status: superseded by AC5-PORTAL-GEOMETRY-04 for current Repair04 formation/crossing semantics

AC5-WALL-PANELS-03.classification: NEW Wall of Force resumption geometry only
AC5-WALL-PANELS-03.rule: Tessellate the authored wall from its fixed lower-left/local anchor into 2.5-foot by2.5-foot logical panels (edge remainders keep their exact smaller size). Antimagic suppresses the intersecting panel portions. On resumption, each panel/portion returns only if its 1-inch volume is clear. Occupied portions stay absent until clear; no push, cut, crush, arbitrary tactical hole or free squeeze is created. Once clear, the exact fixed portion resumes.
AC5-WALL-PANELS-03.status: superseded by AC5-WALL-PANELS-04 for current Repair04 resumption semantics

AC5-PLANAR-FALL-03.rule: Planar Protection supplies no support. If an eligible creature’s continuous ordinary Falling would cross inward and the last exterior boundary point is unsupported, the ward does not arrest or suspend that Fall Marker; the continuous fall may carry the body inside. Once inside, it is treated as already inside for this ward and may leave but cannot reenter after leaving while still eligible. Grounded/otherwise supported forced or voluntary crossings remain blocked at the last legal exterior position.

AC5-BINDING-ORDER-03.classification: NEW Planar Binding pending-order lifecycle only
rule: Each live binder→target record holds at most one pending service order. Issuance requires the binder and target on the same plane, a valid one-way command-intent channel, the binder’s real Bonus Action in initiative or one order opportunity per6 elapsed seconds outside initiative, and a currently source-legal simple order. Invalid issuance spends no order record; normal action-cost commitment follows the actual declaration rules.

A valid order receives its issue timestamp and binds the target’s next regular behavior opportunity after issue: next regular target turn/opportunity in initiative, or next six-second behavior pulse outside initiative. It expires at the end of that one opportunity whether executed, impossible, suppressed or budget-starved. No order is banked/replayed.

A later valid Binding order from the same binder before execution replaces that binder’s older pending Binding order; it does not erase other control effects. Plane change after a valid order does not erase the already-heard instruction, but plane separation prevents new issuance. Lesser Antimagic suppressing the Binding compulsion at the execution opportunity makes that order ineffective for the opportunity and it expires; the 24-hour service clock continues.

Companion/source gates remain prerequisites. Binding never creates the owner’s Companion Command, Action, Bonus Action, Reaction or offense token. If an owner legally opens one commanded companion damaging action and a pending Binding Attack order is compatible with that action but conflicts only on target choice, use Compelled Budget Arbitration/priority to constrain the one available action. If no source-gated action becomes available during the bound opportunity, the order expires without inventing one.

AC5-BARRIER-RECAST-03.classification: NEW Resonance Barrier same-name application/concentration lifecycle clarification
rule: Ordinary concentration transition occurs at the new cast’s legal commitment before Counterspell or fresh Barrier formation. Therefore a same-caster old Barrier that depended on that caster’s concentration ends at commitment and cannot survive a countered, failed, zero-pool or weaker replacement cast unless a future exact source expressly grants that exception.

If a still-live Barrier from a different caster protects the target, compare the fresh offered pool only at successful resolution. Stronger fresh pool replaces the retained application and ends the old Barrier application/concentration. Equal or weaker fresh offer does not replace/refresh the retained pool; the fresh Barrier application ends immediately at resolution and its new caster’s concentration on that application ends, with no refund.
Pool comparisons use remaining retained pool versus fresh offered initial pool. No two pools add.

AC5-ANTIMAGIC-IO-04.classification: NEW Repair04 refinement of Lesser Antimagic input/output and dispel-operation capture; supersedes AC5-ANTIMAGIC-IO-03 where inconsistent
rule: At legal spell/effect commitment, actual costs/components/concentration/cadence resolve before suppression. Ongoing local expressions remain suppressed only where their real body/anchor/area intersects the operative field.

For an instantaneous spell or magical nonspell originating outside, inspect its actual recipient, affected area and/or destination manifestation checkpoint. A local payload that would manifest in the field is suppressed at resolution. Damage/healing there creates no packet/root/rider; an indivisible relocation whose destination footprint intersects fails atomically at origin. Outside-to-outside nonpath travel is unaffected by an imaginary line through the sphere.

For Greater Dispel or another exact multi-effect dispel, first capture the immutable effect set under that source, then snapshot whether each individual captured termination operation is locally suppressed before performing any removal. A termination operation targeting one Lesser Antimagic application ignores suppression from that same target field only. Another independently active Antimagic field may still suppress that termination operation if its operative volume covers the relevant application/operation locus.

Do not re-evaluate a captured termination operation after earlier removals in the same dispel. Thus an inside captured buff whose termination operation was suppressed at the operation snapshot remains live even if the Antimagic field suppressing that operation is ended by another captured operation. There is no second scan or spring-back termination.
This self-dispel exception is operation-local. It neither makes unrelated payloads immune to Antimagic nor lets a dispeller ignore a different suppressing field.
No fictional projectile/path is invented for nonprojectile effects. Genuine projectiles/paths retain their source semantics.

Wizard Spell Preservation remains an intrinsic class protection of the primary spellbook: field suppression can make magical use/access unavailable locally but cannot create a non-artifact ordinary destruction loophole.

AC5-WALL-PANELS-04.classification: NEW Repair04 Wall of Force suppression/resumption geometry; supersedes AC5-WALL-PANELS-03 where inconsistent
rule: Tessellate the authored wall from its fixed lower-left/local anchor into 2.5-foot by 2.5-foot logical panels; exact edge remainders keep their smaller size.

While Antimagic or another exact suppressor overlaps the wall, suppress only the exact intersecting portion of each fixed panel and record that suppressed portion geometry. A portion of a panel that was not suppressed remains solid and cannot be entered merely because another portion is absent.

When suppression ends, process each recorded suppressed portion at its original fixed coordinates. If any part of that recorded portion's 1-inch wall volume intersects a creature or independent object, hold that entire recorded suppressed portion absent until clear. Do not generate a new body-shaped cutout and do not deactivate neighboring wall portions that remained solid.
Once the recorded portion is clear, that exact portion resumes. No push, cut, crush, tactical hole selection, free squeeze or movement is created.

AC5-PORTAL-GEOMETRY-04.classification: NEW Repair04 refinement of Alignment Portal physical aperture/crossing; supersedes AC5-PORTAL-GEOMETRY-03 where inconsistent
rule: Alignment Portal creates two fixed linked vertical apertures, each 5 feet wide by 8 feet high. At cast time record each aperture base-center, floor elevation and outward normal. Origin pose must be perceived, clear and supported within 60 feet/LoE. Destination site metadata must already supply a known portalPose with clear supported staging space sufficient for the intended known portal opening; portal creation itself transports no body or object.

A current Dimensional Anchor does not prevent the linked apertures from forming. Anchor is checked on each actual planar-transition transaction whose transported origin or destination footprint intersects the field; a known blocked crossing commits no movement, while a blocker appearing after legal crossing commitment yields atomic failure at origin under accepted Anchor.

The gateway is bidirectional while active. Voluntary crossing is planar/extradimensional physical-gateway travel and is NOT teleportation. No Escape blocks voluntary crossing; Verdict Absolute and Reign of Ashes do not. This classification is Alignment-Portal-only.

Entering an aperture requires 5 feet of actual path through the gateway and ordinarily costs 5 feet of base movement. Use the accepted additive per-foot cost: terrain rate1 normal,2 difficult or3 severe (strongest terrain only), then add1 for crawling and1 for squeezing. A5ft traversal therefore costs5 times that sum; difficult+squeeze costs15ft, not20ft. A body must fit both the 5-foot width and 8-foot height under current posture/clearance rules. A Large 10x10 body may use ordinary one-size-smaller squeeze only when its stated height/pose and the actual aperture permit it; squeezing adds +1 movement cost per foot and keeps its real penalties.

Forced movement may cross only when the forcing source itself supplies a legal path and enough actual forced distance through the aperture. Do not infer that a Shove can force a body through a squeeze it could not otherwise physically clear. A fitting Medium body successfully Shoved 5 feet directly through the aperture is a sufficient forced-crossing fixture; forced movement is not voluntary, so No Escape's voluntary wording does not block that transit. All arrival gates still apply.

Crossing maps facing relative to entry normal to destination exit normal. Destination placement must fit the whole body in the actual supported staging space; fixed neutral board order breaks equivalent placements. No search through barriers and no body bisection.

AC5-PRICE-01.classification: NEW scoped AC5 price ordering; preserves accepted AC4 Dampening and existing final Influence
rule: Validate that the activation is an actual spell cast and determine the actual casting body at commitment.

Create pricing buckets. creditableBase starts as the actual ordinary base RP amount after exact base-only reductions/waivers/minima. preNexusExtras contains printed ordinary RP extras and Dissonance/strain surcharges that remain discountable but are never Barrier-pool credit. Protected principal such as Resonance Barrier X, materials, HP, ammunition, charges and uses stay outside these buckets.

If at least one operative Resonance Nexus contains the caster at commitment, apply one total -2 to the combined discountable pre-Dampening buckets, minimum0: reduce creditableBase first, then preNexusExtras. Overlapping Nexuses never stack.

If accepted Resonance Dampening Field applies, add its mandatory +2 RP only after Nexus/ordinary reductions. Dampening is noncreditable and Nexus never subtracts it. A genuine charge/use-only spell with no ordinary RP-price interface still receives this accepted +2 interface; Nexus has no earlier RP bucket to reduce.

Apply one pending final Resonance Influence Ease/Burden to the resulting RP-priced spell amount, minimum0. For Barrier accounting only, Ease reduces creditableBase first, then remaining preNexusExtras, then Dampening/other noncreditable final components; Burden adds only noncreditable cost.
Commit the final affordable RP amount together with Action/components/concentration transition. Countering, suppression, save/failure or replacement gives no refund.
AC5-PRICE-01.barrierCreditAllocation: Resonance Barrier pool credit = 5 × (final creditableBasePaid + protectedX). No Dissonance, printed surcharge, Dampening, Burden or other nonbase extra becomes pool credit even if paid. Base-only waivers can reduce creditableBase to0; Nexus/Ease allocations above may also reduce it. Protected X is fully paid separately and fully creditable.
AC5-PRICE-01.chargeOnlyBoundary: An ancestry/use-only spell spends its actual use and has no ordinary RP bucket unless another exact interface creates one. Nexus therefore cannot manufacture or discount a price. Accepted AC4 Dampening alone can add its +2 RP interface; final Influence may then modify that +2. A positive RP amount requires an existing lawful personal RP pool. Paying RP for a nonspell still does not make it a spell.

AC5-ANTIMAGIC-IO-03.status: superseded by AC5-ANTIMAGIC-IO-04 for current Repair04 operation semantics

AC5-PLANAR-ARRIVAL-03.classification: NEW AC5 prospective-arrival provenance timing; operational metadata only
AC5-PLANAR-ARRIVAL-03.rule: For every cross-plane transit into a Planar Protection destination, snapshot prospectiveOriginPlaneKey from the body’s actual plane immediately before the transit. Evaluate the destination ward against that value before placement, regardless of stale lastArrivedFromPlaneKey. On success commit lastArrivedFromPlaneKey=prospective origin; on failure keep the prior record unchanged. No failure reveals hidden provenance/cosmology beyond ordinary observed failure.

rule: Alignment Portal creates two fixed linked vertical apertures, each 5 feet wide by 8 feet high. At cast time record each aperture base-center, floor elevation and outward normal. Origin pose is chosen in a perceived clear supported space within60/LoE. Destination site metadata must already provide one known portalPose with clear supported 5-by-5 staging space on each side; missing pose/clearance makes the cast illegal rather than allowing remote tactical placement.

The gateway is bidirectional while active. A voluntary crossing is planar/extradimensional travel through a physical gateway and is NOT teleportation. No Escape blocks voluntary crossing; Verdict Absolute and Reign of Ashes do not. This classification is Alignment-Portal-only.

Entering the aperture costs 5 feet of base ordinary movement. Apply actual terrain, crawling and squeezing costs to that 5-foot traversal. A Large body may use a 5-foot aperture only if ordinary one-size-smaller squeeze is legal; squeezing adds +1 movement cost per foot and its real penalties. Carried creatures are separate bodies and all members of one packet must fit/support and pass arrival blockers.

Forced movement may carry a body through only if the forcing source supplies enough real movement/path and the body/group passes all arrival gates. Forced movement spends no voluntary movement budget and does not become voluntary travel; No Escape therefore does not block the forced crossing merely by its voluntary wording.

Crossing maps the traveler’s facing relative to the entry normal to the corresponding destination exit normal. AC5-PORTAL-GEOMETRY-03.status: superseded by AC5-PORTAL-GEOMETRY-04 for current Repair04 formation/crossing semantics

AC5-WALL-PANELS-03.classification: NEW Wall of Force resumption geometry only

Antimagic suppresses the intersecting panel portions. On resumption, each panel/portion returns only if its 1-inch volume is clear. AC5-WALL-PANELS-03.status: superseded by AC5-WALL-PANELS-04 for current Repair04 resumption semantics

AC5-PLANAR-FALL-03.rule: Planar Protection supplies no support. Grounded/otherwise supported forced or voluntary crossings remain blocked at the last legal exterior position.

AC5-BINDING-ORDER-03.classification: NEW Planar Binding pending-order lifecycle only
rule: Each live binder→target record holds at most one pending service order. Issuance requires the binder and target on the same plane, a valid one-way command-intent channel, the binder’s real Bonus Action in initiative or one order opportunity per6 elapsed seconds outside initiative, and a currently source-legal simple order. Invalid issuance spends no order record; normal action-cost commitment follows the actual declaration rules.

A later valid Binding order from the same binder before execution replaces that binder’s older pending Binding order; it does not erase other control effects. Plane change after a valid order does not erase the already-heard instruction, but plane separation prevents new issuance. Lesser Antimagic suppressing the Binding compulsion at the execution opportunity makes that order ineffective for the opportunity and it expires; the 24-hour service clock continues.

Companion/source gates remain prerequisites. Binding never creates the owner’s Companion Command, Action, Bonus Action, Reaction or offense token. AC5-BARRIER-RECAST-03.classification: NEW Resonance Barrier same-name application/concentration lifecycle clarification

Outside-to-outside nonpath travel is unaffected by an imaginary line through the sphere.

For Greater Dispel or another exact multi-effect dispel, first capture the immutable effect set under that source, then snapshot whether each individual captured termination operation is locally suppressed before performing any removal. A termination operation targeting one Lesser Antimagic application ignores suppression from that same target field only. Another independently active Antimagic field may still suppress that termination operation if its operative volume covers the relevant application/operation locus.

Do not re-evaluate a captured termination operation after earlier removals in the same dispel. AC5-WALL-PANELS-04.classification: NEW Repair04 Wall of Force suppression/resumption geometry; supersedes AC5-WALL-PANELS-03 where inconsistent

While Antimagic or another exact suppressor overlaps the wall, suppress only the exact intersecting portion of each fixed panel and record that suppressed portion geometry. A portion of a panel that was not suppressed remains solid and cannot be entered merely because another portion is absent.

When suppression ends, process each recorded suppressed portion at its original fixed coordinates. If any part of that recorded portion's 1-inch wall volume intersects a creature or independent object, hold that entire recorded suppressed portion absent until clear. Do not generate a new body-shaped cutout and do not deactivate neighboring wall portions that remained solid.
Once the recorded portion is clear, that exact portion resumes. No push, cut, crush, tactical hole selection, free squeeze or movement is created.

A current Dimensional Anchor does not prevent the linked apertures from forming. Anchor is checked on each actual planar-transition transaction whose transported origin or destination footprint intersects the field; a known blocked crossing commits no movement, while a blocker appearing after legal crossing commitment yields atomic failure at origin under accepted Anchor.

Action; range 60 feet; V/S/F; base 10 RP; concentration up to 60 elapsed seconds; printed CHA save. Target exactly one perceived creature within range/line of effect that (a) the caster currently regards as an enemy from available information and (b) has an actual active summon-source identity proving this body was created/summoned by a still-recognizable source. If the summon source itself ends/expires/dismisses/replaces the body while exiled, the body ends under that source; Elemental Banishment ends immediately and closes the cell, returning only surviving genuine loose cargo. Actual suppression of this exile application closes/ends it rather than pausing. Current endpoint blockers apply at establishment; terminal closure keeps the narrow accepted Banishment-only blocker exception through this explicit extension.

rule: Validate that the activation is an actual spell cast and determine the actual casting body at commitment.

Protected principal such as Resonance Barrier X, materials, HP, ammunition, charges and uses stay outside these buckets.

If at least one operative Resonance Nexus contains the caster at commitment, apply one total -2 to the combined discountable pre-Dampening buckets, minimum0: reduce creditableBase first, then preNexusExtras. Overlapping Nexuses never stack.

If accepted Resonance Dampening Field applies, add its mandatory +2 RP only after Nexus/ordinary reductions. Dampening is noncreditable and Nexus never subtracts it. A genuine charge/use-only spell with no ordinary RP-price interface still receives this accepted +2 interface; Nexus has no earlier RP bucket to reduce.

Apply one pending final Resonance Influence Ease/Burden to the resulting RP-priced spell amount, minimum0. For Barrier accounting only, Ease reduces creditableBase first, then remaining preNexusExtras, then Dampening/other noncreditable final components; Burden adds only noncreditable cost.
Commit the final affordable RP amount together with Action/components/concentration transition. Countering, suppression, save/failure or replacement gives no refund.

No Dissonance, printed surcharge, Dampening, Burden or other nonbase extra becomes pool credit even if paid. Base-only waivers can reduce creditableBase to0; Nexus/Ease allocations above may also reduce it. Protected X is fully paid separately and fully creditable.

Nexus therefore cannot manufacture or discount a price. Accepted AC4 Dampening alone can add its +2 RP interface; final Influence may then modify that +2. A positive RP amount requires an existing lawful personal RP pool. Paying RP for a nonspell still does not make it a spell.

AC5-ANTIMAGIC-IO-04.classification: NEW Repair04 refinement of Lesser Antimagic input/output and dispel-operation capture; supersedes AC5-ANTIMAGIC-IO-03 where inconsistent
rule: At legal spell/effect commitment, actual costs/components/concentration/cadence resolve before suppression. Ongoing local expressions remain suppressed only where their real body/anchor/area intersects the operative field.

For an instantaneous spell or magical nonspell originating outside, inspect its actual recipient, affected area and/or destination manifestation checkpoint. A local payload that would manifest in the field is suppressed at resolution. Damage/healing there creates no packet/root/rider; an indivisible relocation whose destination footprint intersects fails atomically at origin. Outside-to-outside nonpath travel is unaffected by an imaginary line through the sphere.

For Greater Dispel or another exact multi-effect dispel, first capture the immutable effect set under that source, then snapshot whether each individual captured termination operation is locally suppressed before performing any removal. A termination operation targeting one Lesser Antimagic application ignores suppression from that same target field only. Another independently active Antimagic field may still suppress that termination operation if its operative volume covers the relevant application/operation locus.

Do not re-evaluate a captured termination operation after earlier removals in the same dispel. Thus an inside captured buff whose termination operation was suppressed at the operation snapshot remains live even if the Antimagic field suppressing that operation is ended by another captured operation. There is no second scan or spring-back termination.
This self-dispel exception is operation-local. It neither makes unrelated payloads immune to Antimagic nor lets a dispeller ignore a different suppressing field.
No fictional projectile/path is invented for nonprojectile effects. Genuine projectiles/paths retain their source semantics.

Wizard Spell Preservation remains an intrinsic class protection of the primary spellbook: field suppression can make magical use/access unavailable locally but cannot create a non-artifact ordinary destruction loophole.

AC5-WALL-PANELS-04.classification: NEW Repair04 Wall of Force suppression/resumption geometry; supersedes AC5-WALL-PANELS-03 where inconsistent
rule: Tessellate the authored wall from its fixed lower-left/local anchor into 2.5-foot by 2.5-foot logical panels; exact edge remainders keep their smaller size.

While Antimagic or another exact suppressor overlaps the wall, suppress only the exact intersecting portion of each fixed panel and record that suppressed portion geometry. A portion of a panel that was not suppressed remains solid and cannot be entered merely because another portion is absent.

When suppression ends, process each recorded suppressed portion at its original fixed coordinates. If any part of that recorded portion's 1-inch wall volume intersects a creature or independent object, hold that entire recorded suppressed portion absent until clear. Do not generate a new body-shaped cutout and do not deactivate neighboring wall portions that remained solid.
Once the recorded portion is clear, that exact portion resumes. No push, cut, crush, tactical hole selection, free squeeze or movement is created.

AC5-PORTAL-GEOMETRY-04.classification: NEW Repair04 refinement of Alignment Portal physical aperture/crossing; supersedes AC5-PORTAL-GEOMETRY-03 where inconsistent
rule: Alignment Portal creates two fixed linked vertical apertures, each 5 feet wide by 8 feet high. At cast time record each aperture base-center, floor elevation and outward normal. Origin pose must be perceived, clear and supported within 60 feet/LoE. Destination site metadata must already supply a known portalPose with clear supported staging space sufficient for the intended known portal opening; portal creation itself transports no body or object.

A current Dimensional Anchor does not prevent the linked apertures from forming. Anchor is checked on each actual planar-transition transaction whose transported origin or destination footprint intersects the field; a known blocked crossing commits no movement, while a blocker appearing after legal crossing commitment yields atomic failure at origin under accepted Anchor.

The gateway is bidirectional while active. Voluntary crossing is planar/extradimensional physical-gateway travel and is NOT teleportation. No Escape blocks voluntary crossing; Verdict Absolute and Reign of Ashes do not. This classification is Alignment-Portal-only.

Entering an aperture requires 5 feet of actual path through the gateway and ordinarily costs 5 feet of base movement. Use the accepted additive per-foot cost: terrain rate1 normal,2 difficult or3 severe (strongest terrain only), then add1 for crawling and1 for squeezing. A5ft traversal therefore costs5 times that sum; difficult+squeeze costs15ft, not20ft. A body must fit both the 5-foot width and 8-foot height under current posture/clearance rules. A Large 10x10 body may use ordinary one-size-smaller squeeze only when its stated height/pose and the actual aperture permit it; squeezing adds +1 movement cost per foot and keeps its real penalties.

Forced movement may cross only when the forcing source itself supplies a legal path and enough actual forced distance through the aperture. Do not infer that a Shove can force a body through a squeeze it could not otherwise physically clear. A fitting Medium body successfully Shoved 5 feet directly through the aperture is a sufficient forced-crossing fixture; forced movement is not voluntary, so No Escape's voluntary wording does not block that transit. All arrival gates still apply.

Crossing maps facing relative to entry normal to destination exit normal. Destination placement must fit the whole body in the actual supported staging space; fixed neutral board order breaks equivalent placements. No search through barriers and no body bisection.

completeCurrentCard.procedure:

These are selection categories in the current canonical two-axis system, not judgments created by this spell. The choice is fixed for the cast. Create a stationary 20-foot-radius sphere, concentration up to 60 elapsed seconds, with center line of effect. No planar travel prohibition, sacred ground, permanent consecration, faction restriction or creature-type exclusion is added.

At formation, and on later actual creature regular STARTs inside or actual entry into the live field, the Director privately compares the recipient's current actual mechanical alignment record with the selected complete pairs. Both actual axes must be recorded and exactly match a selected pair; an unknown axis is not guessed from behavior, ancestry, faith, faction, corruption or appearance. A genuinely applicable active alignment overlay participates under its own source rules. Protection that specifically prevents this source from using alignment for its predicate prevents the matching application within its stated scope. A Divination-only information protection does not automatically block this Abjuration damage spell, and the spell does not reveal the protected data to its caster. No valid recorded match means no damage attempt, not a public declaration of neutrality or alignment.

Each matching exposed creature makes WIS against the original spell DC for NEW 3d8 force damage, half rounded down on success. Roll one shared raw amount for recipients at the same actual event; different genuine later events can roll again. No radiant/necrotic or deity preference is inferred. Across all Forbiddance applications/casters, each target has at most one save/damage opportunity per numbered round, including creation; choose the earliest eligible operative source for simultaneous overlaps. Record the exposure before the save/damage so immunity, success or prevention does not grant another attempt. Initial nonmatching eligibility consumes no exposure, but a later genuine alignment change requires an actual future START/entry event, not an immediate extra pulse. Forced movement and teleport arrival can constitute actual entry, without extra damage from repeatedly crossing in one round.

Outside initiative, formation can have its eligible first pulse and later occupants have six-second spell pulse opportunities using the same shared interval exposure. Map the next unresolved periodic opportunity to the next actual regular START on entering initiative, without an additional transition pulse. An owner-attached recipient uses its real regular attached-phase start for this stated spell-only tick; if no phase exists the original six-second spell schedule continues without creating an Action/turn. Suppressed opportunities are spent without queued damage; suppression ending is neither entry nor START. No hard-control claim, compelled conduct, movement barrier or continuing damage condition is added.

The source supplies no readout of who matched, saved, was immune or had an unknown/protected alignment. Ordinary actually visible effects remain observable and may support ordinary inferences; the spell does not guarantee secrecy against observation or authorize an additional alignment diagnostic. Leaving the area stops further eligibility without ending the field. Concentration loss, expiry, removal or a newly formed same-caster replacement ends it under the actual source rules. All ordinary damage consequences remain after ending, with no permanent alignment change, historical rewrite, extra corpse effect or claimed cosmology.

A later Purge remains a real paid record beneath the lock and changes no locked effective value until the lock is inactive. For each future qualifying exposure read the actual effective complete pair at that event, never infer undefined axes.

Pure redirection/transfer descendants inherit the existing root. A suppressed event creates no damage packet and supplies no deferred pulse. AC6-PRICE-01.status: NEW AC6 bridge using accepted AC5 pricing order; does not alter AC5.
AC6-PRICE-01.rule: For an ordinary AC6 spell, start from its actual base spell RP price (rank6 generally 13; Alignment Nexus Conjuration8 is 21). Apply accepted Resonance Nexus ordinary -2 spell-price reduction first when genuinely eligible, then mandatory Resonance Dampening Field +2 if applicable, then final Resonance Influence Ease/Strain. A discount never changes generating rank. Resonance Forge cycle 5 RP is protected conversion principal and is not a spell price or subject to these modifiers.

AC6-DAMAGE-ROOT-01.status: NEW per-card dealer/root mapping constrained by accepted Null/damage-root rules.
AC6-DAMAGE-ROOT-01.rule: Forbiddance: caster is dealer at each new field exposure root. Chain Arc: caster is dealer and one shared selection/damage event still creates recipient-specific damage roots using that caster state at root creation. Skybrand: effect has no creature identity; caster is dealer separately for each attack root. Greater Air Pet, Faction Army soldier and Greater Planar Ally are their own creature dealers for their own attacks/auras. Pure damage transfer preserves the original root flag; genuinely new reflected damage follows its source.

AC6-HEAL-TARGET-02.status: NEW scoped target predicate for only Greater Air Pet and Faction Army soldier profiles.
AC6-HEAL-TARGET-02.rule: While the original summon source exists, Greater Air Pet and each Faction Army soldier body count as an active creature and living ally for otherwise legal HP-healing. This grants no natural biology, soul/native origin, resurrection, disease/curse treatment or generic summon healing. A genuine heal above 0 restores the same NullDisabled body without refreshing source duration or command history. Greater Planar Ally uses GA-HEAL-01 instead.

AC6-SUMMON-SUPPRESS-01.classification: NEW AC6 scoped same-body full-suppression lifecycle
rule: NEW explicit scope for these three AC6 profiles: while any part of the actual occupied body intersects operative Lesser Antimagic, apply this whole-body suppression lifecycle. Use the field's actual clipped volume and re-evaluate as the body moves or falls. This extends the accepted AC5 summon-intersection convention only to Greater Air Pet, Greater Planar Ally and each Faction Army soldier; it does not suppress a whole extended wall/field, grant a new effect to another antimagic source, or change accepted AC5 rules.

Full antimagic suppression of Greater Air Pet, Greater Planar Ally, or an individual Faction Army soldier does not end or recreate the body. Preserve the same body identity, HP, Null state, current position, real cargo, source parent and original deadline. All real clocks continue.

While fully suppressed, the body has Speed0 and cannot act, command, attack or provide intrinsic attacks/traits/service permissions supplied by the suppressed source. Narrow rider-only suppression affects only that rider.

Air Pet physical clarification: full suppression suppresses its intrinsic fly/hover expression. If it is unsupported, ordinary Falling begins immediately under the existing Falling bridge. Falling is not frozen by the summon pause. If support is reached before suppression ends, the same body remains there; when suppression ends, its intrinsic fly/hover expression resumes from its actual current state and location. NullDisabled0 by itself does not suppress Hover; the ordinary Combat Action Hover exception still applies there while the source manifestation remains active.

If the original source independently expires, is replaced, dismissed, loses concentration where required, or otherwise ends while suppressed, the body ends normally. If suppression ends first, the same body resumes with no missed action/command replay and no HP/deadline refresh.

sourceRefs.role: accepted Lesser Antimagic local intersection and same-family exception
accepted AC5 scoped body-intersection convention; AC6 extension is new

AC6-COMPANION-01.rule: All actual commanded companions/devices of one owner share one Bonus Action command and one offensive companion Action per numbered round unless a source explicitly overrides it. Commands occur during the owner regular turn, require actual channel/range/perception/LoE as printed, and execute in the attached phase after the whole owner turn. Extra turns do not reset the ledger. A newly created asset may receive an otherwise available command that round, but creation gives no free attack.

AC6-CHAIN-RANDOM-01.rule: At each successor hop, freeze the stable candidate array before drawing. Use a fair physical die with equal face mapping when practical; otherwise use an exact uniform N-entry draw. A legal reroll such as Fate Coin replaces that one original selection result against the unchanged candidate array and must use the replacement. Hidden Director-only draws remain hidden; a player who cannot perceive the die/event cannot spend Fate Coin. Once a successor is committed, later immunity, death, movement or lawful removal does not redraw earlier/later committed successors.

AC6-SEAL-REMOVAL-01.status: Current negative interoperability conclusion; no new dispel permission created.
AC6-SEAL-REMOVAL-01.rule: Resonance Seal protection cannot currently be selectively suppressed and then dispelled through the same accepted Lesser Antimagic/Greater Dispel transaction. Accepted Greater Dispel captures immutable termination operations; only the operation targeting the suppressing Antimagic field ignores that same field. Operations targeting Seal/parent at suppressed loci are suppressed and are not rescanned after field removal. Wizard class Dispel is a rank3 spell and is itself suppressed when its application locus is suppressed. An actual future/selective source could change this only through its exact text.

AC6-NEXUS-TRANSPORT-01.status: NEW scoped Alignment Nexus Conjuration8 classification only.
AC6-NEXUS-TRANSPORT-01.rule: Alignment Nexus Conjuration8 gateway crossings are both planar transitions and teleportation for predicates that expressly reference either. This is source-specific and does not change accepted AC5 Alignment Portal, which remains planar/extradimensional and non-teleport. Voluntary crossing therefore interacts with No Escape, Verdict Absolute and Reign of Ashes according to each exact predicate; forced movement remains governed by the exact voluntary/benefit wording.

AC6-NEXUS-PLANE-BONUS-01.status: NEW bounded Nexus Conjuration8 benefit; no plane ontology claim.
AC6-NEXUS-PLANE-BONUS-01.rule: While the Nexus parent remains live, an aligned creature physically present on the designated destination plane may receive the source-specific temporary +2 Nexus benefit at the events the Nexus procedure states. This does not make that plane intrinsically aligned, identify Wheel cosmology, infer soul/native origin, or grant the bonus after parent ending. Eligibility uses current effective alignment under accepted overlay ordering.

AC6-FORGE-CYCLE-01.status: NEW Resonance Forge conversion interface using Forge revision02.
AC6-FORGE-CYCLE-01.rule: After a legal Forge cast, each complete cycle costs exactly 5 actual RP from one capable present participant plus 10 uninterrupted actual active minutes by the required workers and credits up to 60 adjusted manufacturing minutes in the current source work phase. The 5 RP is protected conversion principal, not an ordinary spell price. Interrupted cycles spend RP/time but give no cycle credit. A completed cycle does not independently stabilize an unfinished phase; source phase boundaries control stabilized work. Ordinary reviewed crafting XP/first-success/triviality remain in force.

AC6-NEXUS-FAMILY-01.status: NEW family guard for the two Alignment Nexus modes.
AC6-NEXUS-FAMILY-01.rule: One Alignment Nexus parent application per caster. Divination6 and Conjuration8 are distinct operations of one source identity; successful replacement ends the previous parent after normal commitment. Each event receives at most one Nexus bonus from this spell family even if multiple geometric/plane predicates might otherwise overlap.

AC6-SUMMON-SUPPRESS-01_repair04PreviousC.status: NEW AC6 scoped completion chosen for coherence with accepted AC5 same-body paused summons.

AC6-CHAIN-GEOMETRY-05.classification: NEW source-specific Chain Arc successor geometry; proposed for joint review, not a global range amendment
rule: Use the actual occupied body volumes in the pre-damage snapshot for every size, including Medium, Large and the caster. A successor is in local range only if one point on the previous body and one point on the candidate body are at most30feet apart AND the straight segment connecting that same pair has actual clear line of effect on the same actual plane. Do not combine the distance of a blocked pair with the line of effect of a different out-of-range pair. Do not mix center measurements for smaller creatures with nearest-body measurements for larger ones.

Include each unvisited qualifying actual creature identity exactly once, including allies, unseen bodies and the caster. Exclude already visited identities, objects, corpses and images. Stable preexisting identity order precedes each fair draw. This is only the successor test: the initial declared target still needs its actual60foot range, caster perception and line of effect.

AC6-SUMMON-SUPPRESS-01_local05PreviousCu.classification: NEW AC6 scoped same-body full-suppression lifecycle
rule: Full antimagic suppression of Greater Air Pet, Greater Planar Ally, or an individual Faction Army soldier does not end or recreate the body. Preserve the same body identity, HP, Null state, current position, real cargo, source parent and original deadline. All real clocks continue.

procedure.activationAndGeometry: KEEP Abjuration6, Action,60feet,V/S/F,base13RP and concentration up to60elapsed seconds. NEW choose a fixed vertical rectangular wall up to30feet wide and15feet high, with1foot thickness, resting on actual ground. Choose its full position/orientation before commitment; every point must be within60feet and caster line of effect at formation. Width and height use whole5foot panels, producing at most18panels. No curved dome, moving wall or physical material is supplied. The initial volume must be free of creature bodies and solid terrain; known conflict fails preflight, a hidden conflict discovered at resolution defeats the whole paid formation. The wall is visible but transparent to ordinary sight/sound and does not itself supply cover.
procedure.eligibility: NEW PB-PRED-01, scoped only to this wall: a creature qualifies if an actual operative source explicitly classifies it as extraplanar, or an actual established native-plane relationship places its native plane elsewhere than the wall's plane. A mere current visitor is not assigned a native plane. A record that expressly changes/suppresses that classification is honored for its stated duration. Without either affirmative established basis, this wall imposes no blocking branch; that operational absence is not proof the creature is native or non-extraplanar. Elemental, Fey, Fiend, Humanoid, summoned, outsider and extraplanar are not interchangeable labels. The Director may record a genuinely NEW campaign creature classification explicitly before play, but may not claim it was recovered from cosmology or infer it from a hidden soul theory.
procedure.physicalCrossing: An operative panel blocks a qualifying creature's attempted voluntary or forced physical crossing at its boundary, including that body carried, dragged, grappled or ridden by another. Every separately transported creature retains its own eligibility; hiding a qualifying passenger under a cloak does not turn it into gear. Stop the actual crossing transaction before any qualifying body intersects the panel; no part is severed, squeezed through by changing its name, or left behind without an independently legal release. Movement used to reach the boundary remains spent; impossible remaining movement is not performed. A nonqualifying carrier can release the passenger through its actual available action and move alone if then legal. Nonqualifying bodies, ordinary objects, air, sound and actual attacks pass under their own rules. Going around a real edge remains possible. The wall deals no damage, imposes no extra save and grants no free force or opportunity attack. CURRENT EXPLICIT VERTICAL-FALL EXCEPTION: apply fallingAndPlacement below when gravity carries a body down through a top/bottom edge; the wall supplies no horizontal supporting face. This exception does not authorize lateral passage through an otherwise operative broad vertical face.
procedure.fallingAndPlacement: Selective wall supplies no horizontal support. Unsupported Falling continues under the ordinary Fall Marker. QUALIFICATION-CHANGE branch: if an existing body becomes qualifying while intersecting an otherwise operative fixed5x5 panel, that entire panel is pending until no qualifying body intersects it; it supplies no blocking while pending. This whole-panel rule is for a body becoming qualifying inside an operative panel, not for antimagic clipping. NEW explicit completion for the existing no-platform promise: downward Falling through a top/bottom edge is not stopped by this selective wall. If that lawful vertical entry creates actual interior body overlap with a fixed panel, mark the whole intersected panel pending until qualifying bodies clear, exactly as for qualification-change occupancy. Other operative panels still block lateral crossing. A lateral forced movement component toward an operative face stops at its boundary while the independent unsupported vertical fall keeps its original marker/distance history. No support, extra save, impact damage or new Fall Marker is supplied by the wall itself.
procedure.teleportAndTerminalReturn: The wall checks an actual transport destination footprint against its operative thickness for qualifying creature bodies; a destination that intersects is barred by this scoped magical endpoint-prevention rule. A fitting destination beyond the wall does not cross a fictitious physical path and is permitted unless another actual rule prevents that transport. An origin alone touching the wall does not bar leaving. Apply each transport source's normal atomic failure/payment rule. Ordinary Banishment's accepted BAN-CLOSE-03 terminal return expressly overrides endpoint transport prevention: this wall cannot keep that ended cell open. It does not remove real terrain or other bodies. If that mandatory return legally places a qualifying body in the wall thickness, the occupied panel becomes pending under the rule above; no general voluntary-transit bypass is granted.
procedure.suppressionAndEnding: The nonphysical ongoing rank6 wall has one parent and fixed5x5 panels. LOCAL-SUPPRESSION branch: a suppressor removes only the exact geometric portions it intersects while concentration/deadline continue. At resumption, each previously suppressed clear portion returns; an exact suppressed portion intersecting a qualifying body remains absent until clear. Unsuppressed portions were never removed. This clipped-portion rule is distinct from the qualification-change whole-panel pending rule. Losing actual ground support invalidates dependent panels for the remainder of this cast. One active Planar Barrier per caster. Expiry, concentration ending or eligible whole-source removal ends all panels.
procedure.currentPanelPrecision: Fixed5ft panels remain the authored wall cells. For local suppression, preserve exact clipped intersection geometry; do not rectangularize a sphere. For qualification change in an otherwise operative panel, pending applies to the whole5ft panel. Neither branch crushes/ejects, tactically reselects a hole, or refreshes duration. For pending-panel occupancy use actual positive-volume interior overlap. Merely touching a neighboring panel face/edge does not occupy that panel. The one-foot wall thickness participates in spherical clipping; y=0 diagrams are cross-sections only.

AC6-HEAL-TARGET-02.status: NEW scoped target predicate for only Greater Air Pet and Faction Army soldier profiles.

AC6-SUMMON-SUPPRESS-01.classification: NEW AC6 scoped same-body full-suppression lifecycle
rule: NEW explicit scope for these three AC6 profiles: while any part of the actual occupied body intersects operative Lesser Antimagic, apply this whole-body suppression lifecycle. Use the field's actual clipped volume and re-evaluate as the body moves or falls. This extends the accepted AC5 summon-intersection convention only to Greater Air Pet, Greater Planar Ally and each Faction Army soldier; it does not suppress a whole extended wall/field, grant a new effect to another antimagic source, or change accepted AC5 rules.

Full antimagic suppression of Greater Air Pet, Greater Planar Ally, or an individual Faction Army soldier does not end or recreate the body. Preserve the same body identity, HP, Null state, current position, real cargo, source parent and original deadline. All real clocks continue.

While fully suppressed, the body has Speed0 and cannot act, command, attack or provide intrinsic attacks/traits/service permissions supplied by the suppressed source. Narrow rider-only suppression affects only that rider.

Air Pet physical clarification: full suppression suppresses its intrinsic fly/hover expression. If it is unsupported, ordinary Falling begins immediately under the existing Falling bridge. Falling is not frozen by the summon pause. If support is reached before suppression ends, the same body remains there; when suppression ends, its intrinsic fly/hover expression resumes from its actual current state and location. NullDisabled0 by itself does not suppress Hover; the ordinary Combat Action Hover exception still applies there while the source manifestation remains active.

If the original source independently expires, is replaced, dismissed, loses concentration where required, or otherwise ends while suppressed, the body ends normally. If suppression ends first, the same body resumes with no missed action/command replay and no HP/deadline refresh.

AC6-CHAIN-RANDOM-01.rule: At each successor hop, freeze the stable candidate array before drawing. completeCurrentCard.procedure: Action; range 60 feet; V/S/F. NEW: create a fixed 60-foot-radius sphere centered on a perceived point within range and line of effect, with concentration up to one minute. It prevents an actual teleportation or planar-transition transaction when any transported body’s origin or destination footprint intersects the area. Cargo travels with its actual body; an object transported independently uses its own endpoints. Do not test an imaginary path between two outside endpoints. Ordinary travel through the area remains possible. The rule applies to willing, hostile and self transport using established location records; it creates no destination or plane. A portal can remain present, but transit using a blocked endpoint cannot complete. A known obstruction fails preflight before payment; hidden obstruction or a field established after commitment can defeat a paid transit, leaving the entire transaction at its origin. Atomic group travel fails together, without splitting bodies or inventory. Ending or suppressing the field allows future otherwise legal transactions but does not retry or refund past attempts. The field does not suppress summons, images, mundane movement, physical forced displacement, spells generally, or effects merely because they once crossed space. There is no save or physical cage. An explicit source exception can bypass only the prevention it actually names.
